text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Now that I'm done shopping, it's time<n>to go train—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my glasses! I can't run with them<n>slipping off
so easily like this. I'd<n>better get them adjusted.

text_block_list.name: Optometrist
text_block_list.text:
How do they feel now? I tightened<n>them to be more
suitable for running.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad I came to a shop that<n>specializes in
sportswear. You were<n>so fast, I should be able to
make it<n>back in time for... Wait.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, but they're a bit tight. Could<n>you loosen the
hinges a little, please?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Ack... Now they feel strange against<n>my nose! I
think the height of the<n>nose pads needs to be—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Oh no, it's already time for training...<n>But I can't
focus like this.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
In fact, my training efficiency will<n>surely drop if I try
to ignore the<n>problem.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
And that will negatively affect my<n>actual race
performance!

text_block_list.name: Optometrist
text_block_list.text:
Um... So would you like me to make<n>another
adjustment?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Ensuring my glasses are<n>properly fitted and
then making up the<n>lost training time afterwards is
the<n>most efficient course of action!
